description: Capabilities for the main Playback window. Least-privilege: only the permissions the app actually uses. The devtools inspector is still available in dev/debug builds via the WebView's native shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+I / right-click Inspect), so the JS-callable internal-toggle-devtools permission is intentionally NOT granted — it shipped in release builds and only widened the local surface (sec-004 / sec-001 F-4).
